notes.title: Latest Game: God of the Forge - Wishlist now!
notes.content: [p]It's been a great few years working on Indirection.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has purchased this game, provided valuable feedback, and most importantly played it![/p][p][/p][p]I have recently co-founded a game studio called [url="https://www.kickflipwizardstudio.com/"]KICKFLIPWIZARDSTUDIO[/url]. notes.title: Indirection 1.0 Released!
notes.content:
Happy holidays! This update is a huge milestone in marking the completeness of this game. Lots and lots of work has been done on this game between a year ago and now (even more when we include the last few updates!).

This update includes a speed running mode with a global leaderboard, and a lot of work has been done on the level editor to improve it.

Here is a short list of what was improved on through this update:
[list]
[*] Added a new mode of gameplay, Speedrun mode.
[*] Added 5 new achievements.
[*] Fixed bugs throughout the game.
[*] Changed around some of the levels.
[*] Fixed a lot of UI bugs.
[*] Changed the ending sequence.
[/list]

A Screenshot of the new menu:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41217995/1d6afcb9894b09a77f97cc7abb7ccf24982022e4.png[/img]

Included is a non-exhaustive list of some of what has been done this past year to make this game the best it can possibly be:
[list]
[*] Added localization support and full translation to Portuguese
[*] Added full Russian translation!
[*] Added Danish language support
[*] Fixed physics issues
[*] Fix some usability issues
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Overhauled menu design and theme:
[*] Added options menu with configurable in-game options:
[*] Option to enable low-graphics mode
[*] Mute in-game sounds button
[*] Enable/disable VSync
[*] Made buttons look better
[*] Less buggy menus
[*] Add custom levels section to menu
[*] Rearrange menu
[*] Update art for some machines throughout the game
[*] Add Beta level editor
[*] Internal work on level layout
[*] Update language localizations
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Steam workshop support
[*] Fix glitches throughout some levels
[*] Adjusted audio loudness throughout the game for some objects
[*] Refactored player movement
[*] UI Optimizations
[*] Fixed crash when creating new level and opening up custom levels menu.
[*] Added 2 new levels!
[*] Did touchups on other levels throughout the game.
[*] Added custom music that plays throughout the game to replace that annoying wind noise.
[*] Fixed some minor glitches with some levels.
[*] Revamped main menu.
[*] Added view credits button to settings menu.
[*] Changed credits music to updated version.
[*] Fixed a few crash bugs.
[*] Added dialog to confirm new game game creation.
[*] Fixed bug where viewing credits modifies the current save game.
[*] Fixed bug where menu focus doesn't release when opening new sections.
[*] Added small lights to catwalks in order to distinguish them from scaffolding,
[*] Added localization to new game menu.
[*] Fixed grid in level editor.
[*] Fixed level editor camera.
[*] Removed load game option when no savegame is found.
[*] Fixed localization in other parts of the game.
[*] Added an epilogue to explain the story of the game.
[*] Added messages between each level.
[*] General quality of life fixes.
[/list]

Happy Holidays everyone!

notes.title: Steam Workshop and Level Editor (BETA) Released! - Indirection v0.4.0
notes.content:
Merry Christmas everyone! This latest update is a major milestone for bringing Indirection out of early access, and adds so much more content for you to enjoy! Indirection now comes with a free level editor and Steam workshop support (both currently in BETA), meaning that anyone can create and play with the limitless number of user-created levels on the workshop.

Screenshots:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41217995/46d1141fd712d22d5a3ea6ca0e7f9833c6f6e52b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41217995/966a5b27deb21aa28390d9de57f3da82d27f914d.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone for the support, and have a great holiday season!

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Update to Godot 3.4.2
[*]Add custom levels section to menu
[*]Rearrange menu
[*]Update art for some machines throughout the game
[*]Add Beta level editor
[*]Internal work on level layout
[*]Update language localizations
[*]Performance improvements
[*]Steam workshop support
[*]Fix glitches throughout some levels
[*]Adjusted audio loudness throughout the game for some objects
[*]Refactored player movement
[*]UI Optimizations
[*]Many, many more smaller changes!
[/list]

notes.title: Level editor + Steam workshop coming soon!
notes.content:
Happy holidays everyone! Since releasing the game, a lot of work has been going on behind the scenes to make [i]Indirection[/i] the best game it could be. Over time, many different features have been in the works. One of these is the long-awaited features is the inclusion of a level editor, which will add the ability for an infinite number of user-created downloadable levels.

This addition will add the ability for anyone to create and upload their own levels with a simple interface, and have almost as much power as the internal tools that have been used to develop the game. You will be able to share your levels with anyone on the Steam workshop, and download other people's projects to play through!

Here are some heavily in-development screenshots:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41217995/b3c3ebd1dff1914a9742db8199276f67ead4df42.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41217995/b47efdef8175ad8552e292a7aeca9f69f49ba0d4.png[/img]

Major progress has been made on the editor and Steam workshop support, and should hopefully be out sometime around Christmas of 2021!
